nameCheck.why: Malaysian atlases write the Great Lakes as "Tasik-Tasik Besar" only loosely; the standard form is "Great Lakes" or "Tasik Great" and the common Malay rendering is "Tasik Besar" (e.g., Wikipedia ms: "Tasik Besar"), so the hyphenated reduplicated plural is a word-by-word translation of a proper name.
